report: We interrupt our scheduled Petalburg Gym report with a developing story.

Unstable openings have appeared
across Hoenn.

Scientists are calling them rifts.

Witnesses describe distant cities
and unfamiliar mountains.

These places do not match the
surrounding landscape.

The views vanish as the rifts close.

Where they lead remains unknown.

None of the rifts have stayed stable.

Do not approach or enter them.

Unusual POKéMON outbreaks have been
reported near the affected areas.

Some of these POKéMON are native
to regions far beyond Hoenn.

How they arrived remains unknown.

Scientists are investigating a link
between the rifts and outbreaks.

Lead scientist Colress is overseeing
the investigation.

Local researchers are assisting him.

(quietly) Colress...?
What is he doing here...?

I recognize the name.
That's all.

Report any unusual sightings to the
research team.

Keep a safe distance from all rifts.
We will bring you further updates as information is confirmed.
after_report:
Rifts, strange POKéMON...
Is that what you wanted to tell me?
I wanted you to hear it before you went outside.
Whatever those things are, they aren't somewhere to go exploring.
You don't have to look at me like that.
Then don't give me a reason to.

What about the POKéMON?
Are they all right?
I hope so. Professor Birch has been looking into the sightings too.
Maybe he'll know what's going on.
Try the house next door first. His family should know where he's working.

Leave the scientists to their work.

If you see a rift, keep your distance.
That's not quite what I asked.
Go on. And keep that package with you. We still don't know who sent it.
